BiblicalUsage: Leshem the town is the city Dan took for itself — not the gem on the breastplate, which shares its name. In Joshua 19:47, "and called Leshem".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Leshem is Dan's second chance — their coast went out too little, so they took Leshem and called it by their father's name.
